## Outcome and ownership
Child of #1357. Resume a task from verified durable execution state without replaying a completed effect or letting a superseded owner commit.

Reuse existing claims, Plan steps, handoff/context, history and durable MCP tasks. [pm-dj98](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/main/.agents/pm/epics/pm-dj98.toon) owns concurrency; [pm-z1kr34](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/main/.agents/pm/milestones/pm-z1kr34.toon) already specifies bounded leases/fencing. #1336 and [pm-szv11n](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/main/.agents/pm/stories/pm-szv11n.toon) own stale-claim diagnostics and conditional takeover. Link/reuse those owners for takeover rather than duplicating their implementation. No current stale-claim reproduction is asserted here.

## Implementation plan
1. Inventory existing execution/task/Plan state machines and persistence. Specify a versioned checkpoint linked to task/Plan identity: completed steps, artifact references and revisions, pending operations, operation IDs/idempotency keys, last verified effect, context dependency fingerprint, next safe action and blocked/input-required reason.
2. Persist transitions through existing atomic audited SDK operations with optimistic revision checks. Distinguish prepared, dispatched, confirmed, failed and unknown outcome. A transport response lost after dispatch remains unknown until reconciled.
3. Compose claim acquisition/renewal/takeover with an ownership generation or fencing token. Every supported state-changing commit checks the current generation atomically; an expired/superseded worker must be rejected even if it later wakes. Keep logical agent identity distinct from process/session identity.
4. Build a pure resume planner that validates artifacts and context dependencies, reconciles pending operations through provider-specific status/idempotency contracts, and returns a bounded next safe action. Reuse output-session references for reads; an output-budget session is not durable execution proof.
5. Define explicit adapter capability boundaries: local commits can be fenced; external systems require their own idempotency/status/fencing support. If absent, return review-required/unknown and never infer exactly-once behavior.
6. Wire CLI/MCP resume/checkpoint projections and contract discovery. Document retention, migration, crash semantics, lease-clock assumptions, cancellation and recovery.

Illustrative names only: ExecutionCheckpoint, resumeExecution, ClaimGeneration, PendingOperationReceipt.

## Acceptance and tests
- [ ] Crash after effect but before receipt cannot cause blind effect replay
- [ ] Resume verifies completed-step artifacts and returns a safe action or explicit blocked/unknown state
- [ ] A stale owner cannot commit after takeover; renewal/takeover races grant one valid generation
- [ ] Lost responses, duplicate delivery and repeated resume produce stable operation identities and auditable results
- [ ] Changed decisions, stale evidence or artifact revisions invalidate affected execution assumptions without deleting prior receipts
- [ ] Fault injection covers every persistence/dispatch boundary, process death, lease expiry, skew, cancellation and concurrent resume
- [ ] Start with deterministic two-worker interleavings and a 10-agent simulation; larger fleet tests reuse the existing scale program
- [ ] Packed SDK and CLI/MCP tests prove parity and bounded resumable output; original claim/Plan APIs remain compatible

## Dependencies and non-goals
Depends on the existing stale-claim/concurrency owners for ownership semantics, and the temporal/coverage contracts from #1357 for evidence validation. No second workflow engine, no blind forced takeover, no automatic external compensation, no exactly-once guarantee for arbitrary third-party effects, and no new mandatory coordination server.

## Linked implementation slices
- Depends on #1358 and #1361 for knowledge/dependency validity and on #1360 for effect/authority checks
- Reuse #1336 and pm-szv11n for the stale-claim takeover slice
- Crash/resume decision scenarios are verified by #1362
